hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); base=$(basename -- "$file" 2>/dev/null); case "$base" in .env|.env.local|.env.production|.env.development|.env.test) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing .env files is blocked to protect secrets (JWT_SECRET, DB credentials). Edit .env.sample instead."}}';; esac
file=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts) npx prettier --write "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; npx eslint "$file" --fix >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; true
